newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Islamic Development Bank approves $140 mln loans.
newsitem.headline: Islamic Development Bank approves $140 mln loans.

text.p: The Islamic Development Bank said on Wednesday it had approved new finances of around $140 million in favour of a number of member countries and Moslem communities in non-member states.

In a statement the bank said it had approved $47.2 million to finance development projects in five member countries, $1.965 million for two technical assistance programmes, $87 million for trade financing packages in four member states and $1.3 million for educational projects for four Moslem communities.

"The Board approved an assistance of $2 million to Islamic Republic of Iran to finance the reconstruction of schools. It also approved an additional grant of $70,000 to Somalia, and $30,000 to the Moslems of Rwanda," the bank added.
The Jeddah-based bank was set up in 1975 to finance and promote trade exchanges between Islamic states.
